key_facts: The project aims to create a remote control that can generate a profit of fifty million Euros.
The remote control needs to be trendy and have a price point of twenty five Euros.
The team acknowledges that twenty five Euros is a high price for a remote control.
The team considers the possibility of incorporating a gimmick such as a whistle feature to help locate lost remotes.
The team discusses the need for a unique design, including color and shape, to differentiate the remote control from competitors.
Marketing suggests evaluating market potential, competition, and design trends before finalizing the project.
The team agrees that the remote control should be attractive and have a good design.
The team decides that the Industrial Designer will research existing remote controls, focusing on shapes, colors, and materials.
The Project Manager mentions the target price of twelve Euros fifty for the remote control.
The team plans to have another meeting in half an hour to discuss further details.
